title: Gumloop alternatives, with checked prices | 50agents
description: Gumloop alternatives: Lindy for a personal AI assistant, Relevance AI for sales AI agents, n8n to self-host, and 50agents to start free. Prices checked.
answer: Gumloop has no free plan, so if you want to try before paying, 50agents is free to start and Activepieces has a free plan for up to 5 users.
If you want AI agents on your own servers, n8n and Activepieces both self-host; for one person's assistant, Lindy fits better, and for sales teams, Relevance AI comes ready-made.
ask: Set up a browser agent that checks my competitors' pricing pages every day at 9:00 and tells me when a price changes
lede: Gumloop is a team AI agent builder: shared AI agents, any model, and IT deciding who may use which tools.

entries.suits: Teams who want fixed steps and AI judgement in one place. Captain decides whether the job is an automation, an AI agent, a browser agent or an app.
entries.limit: Its browser agent cannot get past a login without your OK; Gumloop's browser keeps a credential vault and lets you take over the session.

entries.suits: People whose Gumloop AI agents were really their own assistant: inbox, calendar, meeting notes. Lindy works in Slack, iMessage and email.
entries.price: $50 in credits for 7 days. Team: from $29.99 a month per active user
entries.limit: Billed per active user from $29.99 a month, which adds up across a team.

entries.suits: Revenue teams that want prebuilt teams of AI agents for prospecting and follow-up, with approvals reps answer from Slack or Teams.
entries.price: No free plan. Pro: $19 a month billed yearly (2,500 actions)
entries.limit: No free plan either, and extra actions cost $80 per 1,000.

entries.suits: Teams with a developer who want AI agents and flows on their own servers, with human approval for tool calls and a code node.
entries.price: No free cloud plan. Starter: €20 a month billed yearly (2.5K executions)
entries.limit: More setup than Gumloop: someone builds the AI agent node by node, and the cloud plan has no free tier.

entries.suits: Teams who want a free plan, AI agents, and an MIT-licensed core they can self-host later.
entries.price: Free: 1,000 credits, up to 5 users. Plus: $20 a month flat (10,000 credits)
entries.limit: AI steps cost 2, 10 or 20 credits depending on the model, so AI-heavy work still uses credits quickly.

us: You want to try before you pay, with no card.
Your jobs mix fixed steps, AI judgement and records of their own, and you would rather describe them than build them.
You want sends to people outside to wait for your yes by default.
them: You need IT-level control over which tools and models each person can use. That is what Gumloop is built for.
Your AI agents work in websites behind logins, and you use the credential vault and take over the browser when needed.
You run it on Enterprise, where credits roll over.

move.title: Copy each AI agent's instructions
move.body: We found no export for Gumloop AI agents on Gumloop's own pages, so copy each one's instructions, tools and model before you cancel.

move.title: Split AI agents from flows
move.body: Anything that does the same steps every time is an automation; anything that decides is an AI agent. Moving them as the right kind usually makes them cheaper to run.

move.title: Rebuild from the instructions
move.body: Paste the AI agent's instructions into Captain as the ask. Captain asks what it cannot know, for example which sheet or which Slack channel, then shows the plan.

move.title: Cancel before the next cycle
move.body: Gumloop credits do not roll over, so time the switch to the end of your billing period.

faqs.q: Does Gumloop have a free plan?
faqs.a: No. Its docs describe a 14-day Pro trial that needs a card and becomes a paid Pro plan unless you cancel.

faqs.q: What is the closest alternative to Gumloop?
faqs.a: For team AI agents with controls, Relevance AI. For the same mix of AI agents and fixed steps without building, 50agents. For self-hosting, n8n.

faqs.q: Which Gumloop alternative has a browser agent?
faqs.a: Lindy drives a browser on Pro and up, and 50agents has browser agents for websites with no app to connect. Zapier Agents has a Chrome extension that works on the page you have open.
